name: DKCISSP controlled loopback HTTP regression baseline
scope: Deterministic local fixture signals for HTTP transport, missing security headers, and optional tool evidence. This validates parser behavior only; it is not a vulnerability detection-rate estimate.

expected_signals.description: An HTTP fixture target should produce the transport-encryption warning.
expected_signals.title_contains: Target uses HTTP without transport encryption

expected_signals.description: A response without CSP should be identified.
A response without Referrer-Policy should be identified.
A response without X-Content-Type-Options should be identified.
A response without Permissions-Policy should be identified.
A controlled wildcard CORS response should be recorded as an informational observation, not a confirmed vulnerability.
A supplied in-scope backup-like URL should produce a cautious metadata-only observation without storing its body.
expected_signals.title_contains: Potentially exposed backup or configuration artifact

coverage_boundary: This baseline covers only the seven explicit loopback fixture expectations. It does not measure overall scanner coverage or prove exploitability. Exposed-file detection is limited to supplied or discovered same-origin URLs and does not enumerate arbitrary filenames. Redirect scope is asserted separately by a test that verifies the second local server receives no request.
